description: This file implements a cgroup manager for Linux containers, providing functions to create, modify, retrieve stats, and manage cgroups and subsystems, including handling rootless mode and specific subsystem operations.

classes.name: subsystem
classes.description: Interface defining methods for cgroup subsystems, including retrieving name, stats, applying configurations, and setting resources.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: Struct managing cgroups, providing methods to apply configurations, add processes, retrieve stats, and manage cgroup lifecycle.

methods.name: NewManager
methods.description: Creates a new cgroup Manager instance with specified cgroup and paths.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies cgroup settings to a process identified by pid.

methods.name: AddPid
methods.description: Adds a process to an existing cgroup.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Removes cgroups associated with the manager.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the path of a specific subsystem's cgroup.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves current statistics from all subsystems.

methods.name: Freeze
methods.description: Freezes or unfreezes the container via freezer cgroup.

methods.name: GetPids
methods.description: Returns list of PIDs in the container's device cgroup.

methods.name: GetAllPids
methods.description: Returns all PIDs in the container's device cgroup.

methods.name: GetFreezerState
methods.description: Retrieves the current freezer state of the container.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the device cgroup exists.

methods.name: OOMKillCount
methods.description: Returns the number of OOM kills from memory cgroup.
